mentions.name: Local Ollama TALA code generator
mentions.description: This project trains a local 1.5B-parameter Ollama model to generate TALA code, enabling creation of flowcharts exportable to mermaid and napkin formats for hackathon use; it is currently collecting quality training data and weighing whether the model is feasible with limited snippets versus synthetic data.
mentions.problem: Collecting enough quality training data is hard: cloning the official d2 repository yielded only 79 code snippets, leaving the builder unsure how to train with so little data or whether to generate synthetic data instead.
mentions.audience: Hackathon participants who use mermaid/napkin-style flowcharts
mentions.source_excerpt: i thought like why not we train a local ollama  model 1.5 b parameters and make it generate tala code ,so i can develop flowcharts which we can get in mermaid ,napkin which we use for hackathons
mentions.author: darkhorse_chenn
